scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Education of Children of Registered Construction Worker
other_conditions: Parents or guardians must be registered construction workers under the Building & Other Construction Workers’ Welfare Board
The construction worker must have a continuous registration for at least six months
The registered construction workers must have no dues payable to the Board
Only two children of the same parents/guardians are eligible for scholarships
Scholarships are awarded for all recognized Pre‑Matric and Post‑Matric courses except courses of six months or less
Students studying the same stage of education in different subjects are not eligible
A student who has completed one professional stream and is pursuing another is not eligible; only one professional stream is allowed
The student must maintain at least 50% annual attendance in the class
If a candidate fails to pass a particular year, they will not receive further scholarship until the year is passed
The scholarship is tenable for the prescribed duration of the course
The application must be submitted within six months of the next academic year
For Post‑Matric scholarships, the student must possess the relevant qualification from a recognized institution
benefits_summary: Provides annual financial assistance to children of registered construction workers, ranging from ₹1,800 for lower classes up to ₹20,000 for professional courses.
